title: Filtered colimits in an ind-category are created in presheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal H$ be a small category in a fixed universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the category $\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)$ of small filtered diagrams in $\mathcal H$, with
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)}((C_i),(D_j))=\varprojlim_i\varinjlim_j\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal H}(C_i,D_j).$$
Equivalently its objects are presheaves $\mathcal H^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Set}$ that are small filtered colimits of representables $h_C(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal H}(T,C)$; maps are natural transformations. Filtered diagrams and colimits have the convention of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The category $\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)$ has all small filtered colimits. Its full inclusion into the presheaf category creates these colimits: for a small filtered category $J$ and a diagram $A:J\to\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)$, the presheaf colimit $\varinjlim_j A_j$ is again an ind-object, and the presheaf colimit cocone is the colimit cocone in $\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)$.
